Carpenter Theatre at Dominion Energy Center
Carpenter Theatre at Dominion Energy Center

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Weekdays 11 am – 5 pm Summer Hours beginning June 28 Weekdays 11am - 2pm We will be open three hours prior to performances in Carpenter Theatre and two hours prior to performances in Gottwald Playhouse and Rhythm Hall (at the Grace Street Entrance satellite box office).

venues.parkingDetail: Richmond CenterStage has several parking areas within 2 blocks of the front door. There are over 600 parking spots in the parking deck at the southeast corner of 7th Street and Marshall Street (behind the National Theater) available to patrons after 5:30pm on weekdays and anytime on weekends. Accessible and priority parking spots are available across from Richmond CenterStage, south of Grace Street between 6th Street and 7th Street. The open lot and the parking deck have over 200 spaces available to visitors.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This is an accessible venue. Accessible seating is available through the Box Office and Ticketmaster. For mobility, hearing or sight impairments, patrons are asked to contact the Box Office directly at (804)592-3400

generalInfo.childRule: Ages 2 and above require a ticket. This information is subject to change depending on the event. Patrons are asked to contact the Box Office directly for more information

ada.adaPhones:
Beginning Sep 1, 2009 the box office can be reached at (804)592-3400.
Prior to that date patrons are asked to call (804)343-0144 with ticketing questions
ada.adaCustomCopy:
To better accommodate your needs, Carpenter Center has requested that all accessible seating ticket accommodations be solicited only through their representatives. Please contact a Carpenter Center representative for further help with your ticket purchase.*   Advance ticket purchase may be required.

* Box office information is subject to change.
ada.adaHours:
Standard hours are Mon-Fri 10:00am-5:00pm.         

If there is a performance on a weekday, the Box Office remains open until performance time. 

If there is a performance on a weekend, the Box Office opens 2 hours prior to performance.
